name: Miko Minyo. ~Miko Shimai no Saiyaku na Ichinichi~
original_name: 巫女みにょ。～巫女姉妹の災厄な一日～
source:
Main character receives a parcel that contains a double-headed snake that possesses his head. So when he reunites with two shrine maiden distant relatives, snake poisons his mind with sex thoughts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公收到一个包裹，里面的双头蛇附在了他的头上。当他与两名远房亲戚、巫女姐妹草薙媛子与姫香重逢时，蛇不断以淫念侵蚀他的心智。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
